shortDescription: Create and manage cloud Primary IPs on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: auto_delete
options.description: Delete the Primary IP when the resource it is assigned to is deleted.

options.name: delete_protection
options.description: Protect the Primary IP for deletion.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the Hetzner Cloud Primary IPs to manage. Only required if no Primary IP O(name) is given.

options.name: location
options.description: ID or name of the Location the Hetzner Cloud Primary IP will be bound to. Required if no O(server) is given and Primary IP does not exist.

options.name: name
options.description: The Name of the Hetzner Cloud Primary IPs to manage. Only required if no Primary IP O(id) is given or a Primary IP does not exist.

options.name: server
options.description: Name or ID of the Hetzner Cloud Server the Primary IP should be assigned to. The Primary IP cannot be assigned to a running server. Required if no O(location) is given and the Primary IP does not exist. Use C(null) to unassign the Primary IP from the server.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the Primary IP. Required if Primary IP does not exist
